categories.main_business_segments: Wuhan Huakang Century Clean Technology Co., Ltd primarily operates in cleanroom system integration services, focusing on medical cleanrooms, scientific laboratories, and electronic cleanrooms. The company also engages in the sales of medical equipment and consumables, as well as providing operation and maintenance services for cleanroom systems. Their business model emphasizes a full lifecycle service approach including project consultation, design, construction, commissioning, and after-sales support.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced clean air technology, including patented innovations in air collection and filtration, energy-saving secondary air return, and noise reduction systems. They utilize BIM and digital twin technologies for project planning and energy management. Their R&D efforts focus on smart medical IoT platforms, radiation protection control systems, and intelligent cleanroom infrastructure, integrating IoT, AI, and cloud computing to enhance operational efficiency and safety.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include public hospitals, higher education institutions, industrial electronics enterprises, and scientific research organizations. Major end markets are medical cleanrooms for hospitals, biological and chemical laboratories for universities and research centers, and high-tech industrial cleanrooms for semiconductor and new display manufacturing. The company serves over 800 premium clients including top-tier hospitals and national key laboratories across China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, covering more than 20 provinces and autonomous regions. It has established subsidiaries and offices in major cities such as Wuhan, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Beijing, and Shaoxing, enabling broad national market penetration. There is no significant international operation reported.
categories.supply_chain_position: Wuhan Huakang Century Clean Technology Co., Ltd functions mainly as a midstream system integrator in the cleanroom supply chain. It procures raw materials and equipment from upstream suppliers and provides integrated design, construction, and maintenance services downstream to end customers. The company also manufactures certain medical devices and consumables, complementing its system integration services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in cleanroom technology, smart medical IoT platforms, and energy-efficient systems. It actively develops intelligent operation and maintenance solutions, digital twin energy management, and radiation safety control systems. R&D efforts include patent applications and collaborations with academic institutions to maintain technological leadership and expand into emerging cleanroom segments such as electronic cleanrooms and laboratory environments.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through project-based cleanroom system integration contracts, including design, construction, and commissioning services. Additional income streams include sales of medical equipment and consumables, as well as recurring revenue from operation and maintenance service contracts. The company secures orders mainly via public tenders and direct sales, with a focus on long-term client relationships and full lifecycle service offerings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the domestic cleanroom integration market, especially in medical cleanrooms, supported by extensive industry certifications and intellectual property. It competes against numerous smaller firms with limited technical capabilities and fewer integrated service offerings. Its comprehensive service model and strong R&D capabilities provide a competitive advantage in high-end cleanroom projects, including semiconductor and laboratory cleanrooms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.71 billion, representing a 6.64% year-on-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 66.8 million, a decline of 37.75% due to rising raw material costs and delayed settlements. Total assets grew by 46.22% to RMB 4.23 billion, with net assets of RMB 1.80 billion. The company maintains a positive operating cash flow and has recently issued RMB 750 million in convertible bonds to support expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated cleanroom solutions combining design, construction, procurement, and after-sales services, tailored to high-tech and medical sectors. Its strong R&D foundation, proprietary technologies, and comprehensive service lifecycle create differentiated value by enhancing project quality, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction. The firm’s focus on smart, energy-efficient, and digitally managed cleanroom environments positions it as a trusted partner for complex, high-standard cleanroom projects.
